terms.text: The final quantities and total values of the goods to be shipped may vary by up to ±10% based on actual space availability in the container. The Overall Length of each Pipe will be 3.0 meters (±50 mm). Coupler is additionally fitted.

terms.title: Shipment Terms
terms.text: Shipment within 30 to 40 working days from receipt of confirmed PO, advance payment and all import-related approvals. Partial shipment and transhipment are allowed. Shipment by a non-conference vessel is acceptable. Telescopic stuffing is permitted.

terms.title: Force Majeure
terms.text: Applicable due to natural disasters, war, strikes, government actions, or other unforeseeable circumstances.

terms.title: Freight Charges #
terms.text: Ocean freight being reviewed with the service provider and will be charged at actual in the final invoice at the time of shipment. Any War Risk / Emergency Charges will be charged extra at actuals incurred at any point till the arrival of consignemnt to the port of destination.
